judged_text: The merge-delete still uses `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))` even though the same function was converted to process all calendar references, so only the first calendar reference's event is deleted. Reschedule-with-merge (the newBookingId path) of a multi-reference collective booking leaves stale events on every host after the first, orphaning those calendar entries with no error surfaced.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the function was updated to process *all* calendar references via `filter(...includes("_calendar"))` and a `for (const reference of calendarReference)` loop. However, in the merge path (`if (newBookingId)`), it still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which selects only the first calendar reference. With multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., collective bookings), this would only delete one old event and can leave stale/orphaned events for the remaining references.
